definitions.gloss: period of staleness; stage when a relationship loses its spark
definitions.explanation: A period in a romantic relationship when the initial excitement has faded and both partners feel boredom or indifference toward each other. Commonly discussed in the context of couples and marriage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}って→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: We hit a relationship rut after three years of dating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking about ways to get through the staleness in our marriage.

examples.japanese: {倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}して→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧みよう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Rather than breaking up just because we hit a rut, we decided to try new things together.

notes:
⟦{倦怠|けんたい}→倦怠：06004_kentai⟧ means weariness or languor; {期|き} means period or phase. The compound specifically describes a stage in a romantic relationship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a relationship rut
- {倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to get through/overcome the rut
- {倦怠期|けんたいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: the rut arrives
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倦怠期|けんたいき}: marital staleness
